svg.title: Uno R3 Passive Piezo Buzzer Connections

g.text: Timer2 compare output toggling sets the tone frequency. The resistor limits current if the selected piezo behaves with a conductive component; follow the exact part data sheet.

g.desc: Timer2 compare output toggling sets the tone frequency. The resistor limits current if the selected piezo behaves with a conductive component; follow the exact part data sheet.

g.text: ERC and exact-net checks validate the diagram only; sound has not been tested on hardware.

g.desc: ERC and exact-net checks validate the diagram only; sound has not been tested on hardware.

g.text: Connect Uno D11/OC2A through a 1 kohm series resistor to a passive piezo element. Return its other terminal to common ground.

g.desc: Connect Uno D11/OC2A through a 1 kohm series resistor to a passive piezo element. Return its other terminal to common ground.

g.text: This is not a wiring instruction for a magnetic speaker or an active buzzer module; check those parts and use a driver where needed.

g.desc: This is not a wiring instruction for a magnetic speaker or an active buzzer module; check those parts and use a driver where needed.
